name: Black Panthers Cricket Club
tagline: Fearless on the Field, United as a Pride
history: Founded in 2011 by a small group of friends who shared a single net and a big dream, Black Panthers Cricket Club has grown into one of the most respected outfits in the local league. What began as weekend tape-ball games has turned into a full-fledged club with junior academies, a competitive senior squad, and a community that shows up for every match, rain or shine.
mission: To develop disciplined, skillful cricketers while building a lifelong community rooted in respect, resilience, and the relentless pursuit of excellence.
vision: To become the region's premier grassroots cricket club, producing players who represent city and state teams while giving every member a sense of pride and belonging.

values.title: Discipline
values.description: On and off the field, we hold ourselves to the highest standard.

values.title: Brotherhood
values.description: We are a pride first — every win and loss is shared.

values.title: Excellence
values.description: We train hard and play harder, always chasing improvement.
